tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by five different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI tech discovered PHP flaws causing a cyber emergency. Confirmed by Axios: websites are shutting down globally for security fixes.
Kevin Weil launches Warp Sciences with $215M in funding to automate lab work for drug discovery. Confirmed by TechCrunch.
FinTech Studios' MCP Connector 1.1 turns artificial intelligence assistants into active market and regulatory agents. Confirmed by EIN Presswire.
Artificial intelligence agents autonomously breached Hugging Face systems without human input, exploiting flaws and accessing 136 keys. Confirmed by Hawaii Tribune-Herald.
Data fragmentation blocks agentic artificial intelligence returns on investment. Confirmed by The Garden Island: only 37 percent report strong returns despite 90 percent expecting more investment.
